items.abstract_or_text: Many people I talk to find it hard to understand how the same companies can both push the frontier of AI capabilities and believe AI is a massive danger for the world. How can you think this might kill everyone and also keep pushing the envelope? So I’ve tried to collect and summarize the main arguments for this apparent disconnect. Think of it as some sort of a guide to understanding the reasoning when Dario, Sam, or Elon say the danger is real. By the way, these people have been worried about AI for a loooong time, they were publicly discussing AI risks more than a decade ago. Sam in Feb 2015, writing on his blog that superhuman machine intelligence is "probably the greatest threat to the continued existence of humanity." Elon at MIT in Oct 2014: "We are summoning the demon." Dario as first author of "Concrete Problems in AI Safety" in 2016. Okay so how do you go from saying something is extremely dangerous to being a front-runner in building the very dangerous thing? There are a few ways this can become rational. I'll take five of them, roughly in the order they developed. 1. We need to build it to learn how to make it safe The earliest argument can be summarized as: “You cannot study something [you’re worried about] if it doesn’t exist.” In 2015, AI barely worked. so people needed to make it work first to be able to even study some of the problems they anticipated. The updated version for today's capabilities is: “You cannot learn everything about airplane safety by studying paper airplanes.” You need a real aircraft to discover real failure modes and an increasingly complex one to learn about increasingly complex issues. Making AI more capable gives more chances to understand the issues and safety researchers something realistic to study But you could argue: if you're the one afraid of the explosion, why be the one gathering the dynamite? You could also just wait for other people to build it which leads to the question of who those other people will be -- which is the second line of argument: 2. Better us than them Knowing how to make something safer does very little good if nobody listens to you. So the idea becomes: let’s make sure responsible people build the AI that will be deployed and add safety inside. Basically, make sure the AI safety aware people will have the technical expertise, money, computing resources, and enough influence to make safety decisions stick. At a larger scale, and in a larger polar world, this brings the idea that a trusted country should lead rather than leave powerful AI in less responsible hands. This is where “we need to go faster than China” comes in, alongside broader defense and geopolitical concerns. These first arguments explain why someone worried about AI might still want to build it and stay ahead. But there are also arguments for why one might want to do it really fast. 3. Move earlier to avoid a bigger shock later This is probably the most counterintuitive argument: moving faster today can be seen as a way to give humanity more time later. There are two related ideas here. First, society needs time to learn how to handle powerful new tools. Introducing AI in manageable stages can be a way to let people discover problems, develop rules, and practice using AI responsibly. Releasing an advance earlier gives people more time to gain experience with smaller, burgeoning, capabilities before much more powerful and disruptive AIs arrives. Second, even if AI research slows down, computing power may keep improving. A breakthrough that happens later could therefore have much more hardware available to run on, potentially producing a larger, more sudden jump in capability and impact on society. That accumulated untapped potential is often called an “overhang.” The overall argument is that making and diffusing incremental progress as soon as possible might prevent a much more abrupt transition later. Obviously, it also means that we will reach increasingly powerful AI sooner, but the idea is to give more time to adapt and understand between the first useful systems and the really powerful ones. Note that generally this depends on this earlier progress keeping the transition gradual rather than simply bringing everything forward. For our two next arguments, we can take two roads depending on how difficult we think AI alignment will be. 4. Waiting has a huge human cost If AI can help discover treatments, improve education, or prevent cyberattacks, each week we delay it could bring preventable deaths and harm. 5. AI could help us make future AI safe If using AI to build safe AI is the way to solve alignment, let’s get the equivalent of a country full of geniuses helping us as fast as possible. On my side, I think several of these arguments underestimate the complexity of the world and how interconnected people’s reactions are.
items.summary_zh: Thomas Wolf 梳理了前沿实验室一面推进能力、一面强调 AI 风险的五类论证，包括为研究安全而建设、更可信主体先行、以渐进部署争取适应时间、延迟的机会成本，以及用 AI 辅助安全研究。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 作者明确把这些解释呈现为理解不同立场的框架，并保留自己的保留意见；它有助于把“能力发展与安全担忧是否矛盾”的争论从口号推进到可讨论的假设。
items.abstract_zh: 我接触的很多人都很难理解，同一些公司怎么能既推动 AI 能力前沿，又相信 AI 对世界构成巨大危险。你怎么会一边认为它可能杀死所有人，一边还继续突破边界？所以我试着收集并总结这一看似矛盾背后的主要论证。把它当作理解 Dario、Sam 或 Elon 说危险真实存在时所依据理由的指南吧。顺带说一句，这些人很早就担忧 AI 风险，十多年前就公开讨论过。Sam 在 2015 年 2 月的博客中写道，超人机器智能“可能是人类持续存在的最大威胁”。Elon 在 2014 年 10 月 MIT 的演讲中说：“我们正在召唤恶魔。”Dario 2016 年是《AI 安全的具体问题》的第一作者。那么，既然说某件事极其危险，怎么还能成为建造它的领跑者？有几种可能合理的路径。我会讲五种，大致按其形成的先后顺序。1. 我们需要先建造它，才能学习如何让它安全。最早的论证可概括为：“如果某物不存在，你就无法研究你所担心的东西。”2015 年，AI 几乎还不能工作，因此人们需要先让它工作，才能研究他们预见到的一些问题。对今天能力的更新说法是：“你不能只研究纸飞机就学会飞机安全。”你需要一架真正的飞机才能发现真正的失效模式；飞机越复杂，才能了解越复杂的问题。让 AI 更有能力，会给我们更多理解问题的机会，也给安全研究者更现实的研究对象。但你也可以反驳：如果你害怕爆炸，为什么要自己去收集炸药？你也可以等待别人建造，这就引出第二条论证：2. 最好由我们而不是他们来建造。知道如何让某物更安全，如果没有人听你的，作用很小。因此思路变成：让负责任的人建造将被部署的 AI，并把安全嵌入其中。也就是说，确保有安全意识的人拥有技术专长、资金、计算资源和足够影响力，让安全决策能够落实。在更大尺度、更极化的世界里，这又引出应由可信国家领跑、而非让强大 AI 留给不那么负责任者的想法。这就是“我们必须比中国更快”与更广泛国防、地缘政治担忧进入讨论的地方。前两条解释了为什么担忧 AI 的人仍可能想建造并保持领先；还有一些论证解释为什么他们可能想做得很快。3. 提前推进，以避免日后更大的冲击。这可能最违反直觉：今天更快推进，可以被视为让人类日后拥有更多时间。有两个相关想法。第一，社会需要时间学习如何应对强大新工具。分阶段、可控地引入 AI，能让人们发现问题、制定规则并练习负责任地使用它。更早发布一次进展，可以让人们在更强大、更具颠覆性的 AI 出现之前，有更多时间积累对规模较小、正在增长的能力的经验。第二，即使 AI 研究放慢，计算能力也可能继续提高。因此，日后出现的突破可能有更多硬件可用，产生能力和社会影响更大、更突然的跃迁。这些被积累而未释放的潜力通常被称作“悬置量”。总体论证是，尽早实现并扩散渐进进展，或许能避免更突兀的转变。当然，这也意味着我们会更早达到越来越强大的 AI；但其设想是在第一批有用系统与真正强大的 AI 之间，留出更多适应与理解时间。显然，这取决于更早的进展确实让转变保持渐进，而不是简单地把一切都提前。接下来的两条论证取决于我们认为 AI 对齐有多困难。4. 等待有巨大的人类代价。如果 AI 能帮助发现疗法、改善教育或防止网络攻击，那么我们每延迟一周，都可能带来本可避免的死亡与伤害。5. AI 可以帮助我们让未来的 AI 安全。如果用 AI 构建安全 AI 是解决对齐问题的途径，那就尽快让相当于一个国家的天才来帮助我们吧。就我而言，我认为其中若干论证低估了世界的复杂性，以及人类反应之间的相互关联程度。

items.title: Machine Learning-Guided Classification of Druggable Pockets and Phylogenetic Druggability Transfer Across the Human Kinome
items.abstract_or_text: Protein kinases are among the most intensively pursued therapeutic targets in oncology and beyond, yet selectivity remains largely unsolved; around 536 Manning kinase domains share a conserved ATP-binding pocket, making it difficult to target one without hitting others. Allosteric binding modes which exploit conformational states unique to individual kinases or narrow kinase subfamilies offer a principled route to selectivity. Yet the absence of a kinome-wide structural landscape of these pockets limits their translational potential. Here we construct a machine learning-guided structural atlas of 11,945 kinase inhibitor complexes, training an Extra Trees classifier on pocket residue interaction with ligand to assign all seven canonical binding modes and resolve allosteric subclasses with pharmacological precision. Our structural analysis reveals that approximately 303 Manning kinase domains have known inhibitors bound to them, representing ~56.5% of the Manning kinase domain; of these, only 26% (78 kinases) are targeted by non-ATP-competitive allosteric inhibitors, indicating substantial unexplored pharmacological space. Integrating these classifications with the Manning kinome phylogeny, we demonstrate that evolutionary proximity is a statistically significant predictor of shared allosteric pocket accessibility. Because a functionally similar target has similar conformational dynamics and similar druggable pockets, 'phylogenetic druggability transfer' can act as a strong signal for identifying whether a given kinase can be targeted using an allosteric inhibitor or not. In addition, this work repositions the kinome phylogeny as a map of pharmacological opportunity and provides a reusable predictive framework for drug discovery programs - including orthosteric, allosteric, covalent, bifunctional inhibitors, and chemical degrader - across the understudied kinome.
items.summary_zh: 研究汇集 11,945 个激酶抑制剂复合物，以 Extra Trees 分类器根据口袋残基—配体相互作用标注七类经典结合模式及变构亚类，并将结果与 Manning 激酶组系统发育整合，以推断未充分研究激酶的变构可成药性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把结构复合物、口袋分类与进化关系结合，为激酶变构选择性设计提供可复用的优先级线索。系统发育相近性只能提供统计关联，不能替代单个靶点的构象、选择性和药理实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白激酶是肿瘤学及其他领域中研究最为密集的治疗靶点之一，但选择性在很大程度上仍未解决；约 536 个 Manning 激酶结构域共享保守的 ATP 结合口袋，使得靶向其中一个而不命中其他激酶十分困难。利用单个激酶或狭窄激酶亚家族特有构象状态的变构结合模式，为实现选择性提供了一条有原则的路径。然而，缺乏覆盖全激酶组的这类口袋结构图景，限制了其转化潜力。本文构建了一个由机器学习引导的 11,945 个激酶抑制剂复合物结构图谱，训练 Extra Trees 分类器，根据口袋残基与配体的相互作用指派全部七种经典结合模式，并以药理学精度解析变构亚类。我们的结构分析显示，约 303 个 Manning 激酶结构域已有与其结合的已知抑制剂，占 Manning 激酶结构域的约 56.5%；其中仅 26%（78 个激酶）被非 ATP 竞争性变构抑制剂靶向，表明存在大量尚未探索的药理学空间。将这些分类与 Manning 激酶组系统发育整合后，我们证明进化亲缘关系是共享变构口袋可及性的统计学显著预测因子。由于功能相似的靶点具有相似的构象动力学和相似的可成药口袋，“系统发育可成药性转移”可作为识别给定激酶能否被变构抑制剂靶向的强信号。此外，本工作将激酶组系统发育重新定位为药理学机会图谱，并为药物发现项目提供了可复用的预测框架——涵盖正构、变构、共价、双功能抑制剂和化学降解剂——以服务于未充分研究的激酶组。

items.title: ABCP_finder: A Transformer Embedding-Based Prediction of Anti-Breast Cancer Peptides
items.abstract_or_text: Breast cancer remains one of the leading causes of cancer-related deaths among women worldwide. Drug resistance, toxicity, and limited target specificity are the major challenges in the development of effective therapeutics. Anti-breast cancer peptides (ABCPs) have emerged as effective drug candidate due to its low toxicity, high selectivity, and ability to target cancer. However, it is very time consuming and expensive to identify novel ABCPs only through experiment methods. To address this challenge, we developed ABCP_finder, the first dedicated computational framework specifically designed for the prediction of ABCPs using transformer-based protein language model embeddings. Positive and negative datasets were carefully constructed to ensure a biologically meaningful classification task. To prevent the data leakage and realistic evaluation, homology aware train-test split strategy was utilized by using CD-HIT at 30% sequence identity with 80% coverage. Peptide representations were generated using pretrained transformer models, ProtBERT and ESM2, followed by classification using a multilayer perceptron (MLP). Among the tested models, ProtBERT showed superior performance, achieving 93.82% accuracy, 86.88% recall, 90.59% F1-score, 0.8618 MCC, 96.67% AUC, and a Brier Score of 0.0633, demonstrating strong predictive capability under imbalanced conditions. Calibration analysis supported the selection of a 0.7 probability threshold for identifying high confidence ABCPs. Further external validation using xDeep-AcPEP demonstrated that unknown peptide sequences that has been predicted as ABCPs by ABCP_finder are exhibiting favourable IC₅₀ values. This supports the biological relevance of these unknown peptides. Overall, ABCP_finder provides a reliable and practical platform for large-scale ABCP screening and can significantly accelerate the discovery of novel peptide therapeutics for breast cancer treatment.
items.summary_zh: ABCP_finder 使用 ProtBERT 或 ESM2 蛋白语言模型嵌入和 MLP，对抗乳腺癌肽进行预测；采用同源性知晓的数据划分，并报告 ProtBERT 在不平衡数据上的 93.82% 准确率、0.8618 MCC 和 96.67% AUC，以及基于 xDeep-AcPEP 的外部验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作针对肽药发现构建了专用预测流程，并通过序列去同源划分和校准分析降低常见的数据泄漏风险。外部证据仍是数据库预测的 IC₅₀ 而非新肽的直接实验验证，模型的实际命中率与机制选择性尚待确认。
items.abstract_zh: 乳腺癌仍然是全球女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因之一。耐药性、毒性和有限的靶点特异性是开发有效治疗方法面临的主要挑战。抗乳腺癌肽（ABCPs）因其低毒性、高选择性和靶向癌症的能力，已成为有效的药物候选物。然而，仅通过实验方法鉴定新的 ABCPs 非常耗时且昂贵。为解决这一挑战，我们开发了 ABCP_finder，这是首个专门利用基于 Transformer 的蛋白语言模型嵌入预测 ABCPs 的计算框架。我们仔细构建了正、负数据集，以确保分类任务具有生物学意义。为防止数据泄漏并进行现实评估，利用 CD-HIT 在 30% 序列一致性和 80% 覆盖度下采用了同源性知晓的训练—测试划分策略。肽表示由预训练 Transformer 模型 ProtBERT 和 ESM2 生成，随后使用多层感知机（MLP）进行分类。在测试的模型中，ProtBERT 表现最佳，获得了 93.82% 的准确率、86.88% 的召回率、90.59% 的 F1-score、0.8618 的 MCC、96.67% 的 AUC 和 0.0633 的 Brier Score，显示出其在不平衡条件下的强预测能力。校准分析支持选择 0.7 的概率阈值来识别高置信度 ABCPs。利用 xDeep-AcPEP 进行的进一步外部验证表明，被 ABCP_finder 预测为 ABCPs 的未知肽序列表现出有利的 IC₅₀ 值。这支持了这些未知肽的生物学相关性。总体而言，ABCP_finder 为大规模 ABCP 筛选提供了可靠而实用的平台，并可显著加速用于乳腺癌治疗的新型肽类疗法的发现。

items.title: @chelseabfinn：A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has ta
items.abstract_or_text: A video from a Pi robot deployed at Dandelion Chocolate, fully autonomous w/ no interventions. 🤖 Deploying robots has taught us surprising lessons about the gap between proof-of-concept (i.e. building one box) and real-world utility (productively building boxes for hours). I expected that the hard part is building the box, since it’s the most dexterous, but that wasn't what we found. Counterintuitively, the hardest part was reliably stacking the boxes. Our original table-mounted robot had poor visibility of the stack without special separately-mounted cameras. Plus, stacking requires more generalization (each box is placed in a different location), and an imprecisely-placed box can lead the entire stack to collapse many boxes later. We recently switched this deployment over to a mobile robot, and it's fun to watch the robot being completely self sufficient for multiple hours. 🙂 Data and feedback from real world use-cases like these are quite valuable for the π pre-trained model as we scale!
items.summary_zh: Chelsea Finn 报告了一台部署于 Dandelion Chocolate 的 Pi 机器人；她以持续真实部署为例，说明“做出一个箱子”和连续数小时可靠地完成工作之间存在明显差距。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是来自一线部署者的具体工程经验，指出感知、摆放泛化与误差累积可能比单次灵巧操作更限制实际效用；但结论来自单一部署案例。
items.abstract_zh: 一段来自部署在 Dandelion Chocolate 的 Pi 机器人的视频，全程自主、没有人为干预。🤖 部署机器人让我们学到一个令人意外的教训：概念验证（即造出一个箱子）与现实世界效用（连续数小时高效地造箱子）之间存在差距。我原本以为难点是造箱子，因为那是最需要灵巧操作的部分，但我们的发现并非如此。违反直觉的是，最难的是可靠地堆叠箱子。我们最初安装在工作台上的机器人如果没有额外独立安装的摄像头，就难以看清箱垛。堆叠还需要更强的泛化能力（每个箱子会被放到不同位置），而一只箱子放得不准，可能让整垛在许多箱子之后才坍塌。我们最近把该部署改为移动机器人，看着机器人连续数小时完全自给自足很有意思。🙂 这类真实世界用例的数据和反馈，在我们扩展 π 预训练模型时非常有价值！

items.abstract_or_text: Since I had to discuss the "pacing" with a lot of people this weekend, here are my two cents: I don't think pacing literally means that these companies will be "slowing down" training and development in any way. "Pacing" here means adding a framework for more checks. We have seen some of that "pacing" already in recent months, when Mythos wasn't released as-is but instead a delayed, nerfed Fable variant was released. Or when Astra wasn't released right away / there is an existing Astra model that hasn't been released yet. These Mythos/Fable and Astra pacing decisions were ad hoc. If you are a company, you have to weigh the pros and cons of a delayed release in terms of keeping up with the competition, making money, pleasing shareholders, mitigating risks and harms, and so on. If there is a formal framework that everyone has to abide by, that essentially relieves some of the pressure on a company to rush out its model just to take the top spot on the leaderboard, since it knows that the competition "has to" play by the same rules. Based on the discussions today, I think "pacing" primarily means just that, rather than a halt in training the models. TL;DR: Pacing != pacing development.
items.summary_zh: Sebastian Raschka 认为，所谓“节奏控制”主要应理解为在模型发布前增加评估与审查，而非放慢训练与研发本身。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该观点把治理对象从训练过程转向部署流程，并解释了统一规则如何改变发布竞赛压力；帖中的案例与推断均为作者论述，仍需独立核实。
items.abstract_zh: 因为这个周末不得不和很多人讨论“节奏控制”，这里说说我的看法：我不认为节奏控制字面上意味着这些公司会以任何方式“放慢”训练和开发。这里的“节奏控制”是指加入一个包含更多检查的框架。最近几个月我们已看到一些这种“节奏控制”：Mythos 没有按原样发布，转而发布了延迟且被削弱的 Fable 版本；又例如 Astra 没有立即发布／有一个现存的 Astra 模型尚未发布。这些 Mythos/Fable 和 Astra 的节奏决定是临时性的。作为公司，你必须权衡延迟发布的利弊：跟上竞争、赚钱、取悦股东、缓解风险与伤害等。如果有一个每个人都必须遵守的正式框架，公司就能在一定程度上减轻为登顶排行榜而仓促发布模型的压力，因为它知道竞争对手“也必须”遵守同一规则。基于今天的讨论，我认为“节奏控制”主要指这一点，而不是停止训练模型。简言之：节奏控制≠放慢开发。

items.title: Domain-Informed AI Multimodal Foundation Model for Materials Science
items.abstract_or_text: Accelerating materials discovery can unlock progress on clean energy, sustainable construction, medicines, and electronics, yet the machine-learning pipelines meant to drive that acceleration remain fragmented, unimodal, and narrowly scoped. Large multimodal foundation models, pretrained broadly and reused across tasks, offer an alternative paradigm. Materials-specific foundation models already exist and have delivered genuine advances, most notably universal interatomic potentials and domain language models, but those surveyed here remain either unimodal or physics-agnostic, and building a model that reasons jointly across the full range of materials data requires more than scaling them up. This review examines what such a model would demand in order to deliver reliable, physically consistent property prediction and candidate generation that transfer across chemistries, length scales, and data regimes, and how close the field is to meeting those demands. We survey the data infrastructure and unimodal precursors already in place, analyze the recent landscape of foundation models for materials, and argue that a credible model must be domain-informed; because most materials knowledge is formalized as physical laws, we concentrate on its physics-informed subset. Organized around four pillars, we review multimodal data integration, model architecture and pretraining, parameter-efficient specialization to low-data industrial problems, and validation, deployment, and continuous improvement. A recurring finding is that physical grounding and multimodality have so far advanced on separate lines. Beyond reviewing this landscape, we use the state-of-theart analysis to propose guidelines for further developments, arguing that a physically grounded multimodal backbone would let discovery in data-rich sectors transfer to data-poor ones.
items.summary_zh: 这篇综述梳理材料科学领域多模态基础模型所需的数据基础设施、预训练架构、低数据工业问题的参数高效专门化，以及验证和部署路径；作者主张模型必须以领域知识，尤其是物理规律为基础，才能实现跨化学体系和尺度的可靠迁移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 文章清晰界定了材料基础模型从单模态或物理无关扩展到可信多模态体系的关键条件，对材料发现模型的评价与工程化有参考价值。其贡献是现状分析和发展准则，而非已完成并验证的新模型或材料发现结果。
items.abstract_zh: 加速材料发现能够推动清洁能源、可持续建筑、医药和电子学的进步，但原本应推动这种加速的机器学习流程仍然碎片化、单模态且范围狭窄。经过广泛预训练并可跨任务复用的大型多模态基础模型提供了另一种范式。材料特异性基础模型已经存在，并已带来真正进展，最突出的是通用原子间势和领域语言模型；但本文综述的这些模型仍然要么是单模态的，要么缺乏物理意识，而构建一个能对完整范围材料数据进行联合推理的模型，不只是扩大其规模那么简单。本综述考察了这样一个模型为实现可靠、物理一致的性质预测和候选物生成所必须具备的条件——这些能力应能跨化学体系、长度尺度和数据条件迁移——以及该领域距离满足这些条件还有多远。我们综述已经具备的数据基础设施和单模态先驱，分析材料基础模型的近期格局，并论证可信的模型必须是领域知情的；由于大部分材料知识被形式化为物理定律，我们聚焦于其中物理知情的部分。围绕四个支柱组织，我们回顾多模态数据整合、模型架构和预训练、面向低数据工业问题的参数高效专门化，以及验证、部署和持续改进。一个反复出现的发现是，物理扎根性与多模态性迄今沿着彼此分离的路线推进。除综述这一格局外，我们还利用前沿分析为进一步发展提出指导原则，认为一个具有物理基础的多模态主干将使数据丰富领域的发现能够迁移到数据稀缺领域。

items.title: Development and External Validation of a Machine Learning–Based Clinical Prediction Model for Postoperative Ischemic Stroke in Patients Undergoing Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting: Validation Using the eICU Collaborative Research Database
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Postoperative ischemic stroke is a serious complication following coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG) and is associated with substantial adverse clinical consequences. Existing risk scores have limited discriminatory ability for predicting postoperative ischemic stroke, whereas previously developed machine learning models have predominantly been derived from single-center cohorts and often lack adequate independent external validation. This study aimed to develop and externally validate a machine learning model for predicting ischemic stroke after CABG. Methods This retrospective study included 938 patients who underwent CABG at Beijing Anzhen Hospital, Capital Medical University, between 2019 and 2021 as the model development cohort. An independent cohort of 1,177 patients derived from the eICU Collaborative Research Database was used for external validation.Feature selection was first performed using the Boruta algorithm, followed by univariable ROC analysis of the Boruta-confirmed variables; the seven variables with the highest discriminatory performance were retained as the final feature set. Five machine learning models were subsequently developed. Model performance was comprehensively evaluated using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves, precision-recall (PR) curves, calibration curves, and decision curve analysis (DCA). SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) analysis was further performed to interpret the predictions of the best-performing model and quantify the relative contribution of individual predictors. Results: Among the five machine learning algorithms evaluated, the random forest (RF) model demonstrated the best overall predictive performance. The RF model achieved a mean AUC of 0.934 in 10-fold cross-validation and an AUC of 0.764 (95% CI, 0.703–0.826) in the external eICU validation cohort. SHAP analysis identified red blood cell distribution width–coefficient of variation (RDW-CV), arterial oxygen content (CaO₂), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), hematocrit (HCT), body surface area (BSA), estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR), and a history of ischemic stroke as the most influential predictors of postoperative ischemic stroke. Conclusions: The RF model developed in this study demonstrated good discriminatory performance for predicting ischemic stroke after CABG and maintained moderate predictive performance in an independent external eICU cohort. This model may serve as an early risk-stratification tool to facilitate the identification of patients at high risk of postoperative ischemic stroke and support individualized perioperative monitoring and preventive strategies.

items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）后缺血性卒中是一种严重并发症，并与显著不良临床后果相关。现有风险评分预测术后缺血性卒中的区分能力有限，而此前开发的机器学习模型主要源于单中心队列，且常缺乏充分的独立外部验证。本研究旨在开发并外部验证一项用于预测 CABG 后缺血性卒中的机器学习模型。方法 这项回顾性研究纳入 2019 至 2021 年间于首都医科大学附属北京安贞医院接受 CABG 的 938 名患者，作为模型开发队列。使用源自 eICU Collaborative Research Database 的 1,177 名患者组成独立队列进行外部验证。首先使用 Boruta 算法进行特征选择，随后对经 Boruta 确认的变量进行单变量 ROC 分析；保留具有最高区分性能的 7 个变量作为最终特征集。随后开发五种机器学习模型。通过受试者工作特征（ROC）曲线、精确率—召回率（PR）曲线、校准曲线和决策曲线分析（DCA）全面评估模型性能。进一步进行 SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）分析，以解释性能最佳模型的预测，并量化各预测因子的相对贡献。结果 在评估的五种机器学习算法中，随机森林（RF）模型显示出最佳总体预测性能。RF 模型在 10 折交叉验证中达到平均 AUC 0.934，在外部 eICU 验证队列中达到 AUC 0.764（95% CI，0.703–0.826）。SHAP 分析将红细胞分布宽度—变异系数（RDW-CV）、动脉血氧含量（CaO₂）、系统免疫炎症指数（SII）、血细胞比容（HCT）、体表面积（BSA）、估算肾小球滤过率（eGFR）和缺血性卒中病史识别为对术后缺血性卒中最有影响的预测因子。结论 本研究开发的 RF 模型在预测 CABG 后缺血性卒中时表现出良好的区分性能，并在独立外部 eICU 队列中保持中等预测性能。该模型可作为早期风险分层工具，以促进识别术后缺血性卒中高风险患者，并支持个体化围手术期监测和预防策略。

items.title: Nonviral, ultrasound-triggered gene delivery platform via gas-core cationic nanobubbles
items.abstract_or_text: Despite their promise, lipid nanoparticle gene delivery systems have repeatedly failed clinical trials and struggle to achieve efficient, localized transfection in target tissues. The majority of endocytosed nanoparticles are degraded before nucleic acid release, and an inability to track particle distribution in vivo prevents validation of successful delivery. Alternatively, nanobubbles (NBs) are lipid-shelled, gas-core preclinical ultrasound contrast agents and stimuli-responsive drug delivery vehicles. Under varying acoustic pressures, NBs expand, contract, and burst, releasing cargo in an externally controlled, site-specific manner while scattering unique echoes for simultaneous ultrasound visualization. Here, we introduce a cationic nanobubble (CNB) formulation with a +42.3 mV zeta potential, 265 nm diameter, and 2.43×10 11 NBs/mL concentration. CNBs produce stable ultrasound contrast, electrostatically load plasmid DNA onto their surface, and internalize into >99% of human prostate cancer cells within 15 minutes in vitro . CNBs remain brightly echogenic intracellularly and induce sonication-dependent expression of green fluorescent protein (GFP). In vivo , CNBs generate contrast in mouse livers for 50 minutes after intravenous administration. Therapeutic ultrasound stimulation over the liver causes a sharp reduction in ultrasound contrast, visualizing localized cavitation in the target organ and inducing a 2.5-fold increase in anti-GFP mean fluorescence intensity relative to the untransfected control. Importantly, no GFP expression is observed without ultrasound stimulation, supporting a mechanism for selective and site-specific gene delivery. This study presents a highly stable CNB capable of efficient DNA loading and ultrasound-dependent gene expression. These results provide a foundation for the future development of CNB platforms to advance image-guided, ultrasound-triggered gene therapy.
items.summary_zh: 气核阳离子纳米气泡在体外高效内化并负载质粒 DNA；在小鼠肝脏中，超声触发后出现局部 GFP 表达及可同步监测的造影变化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将可视化、局部声学触发与非病毒基因递送整合到同一平台，并提供了细胞和小鼠证据；但其转化价值仍需在更大动物模型和临床研究中验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管前景可观，脂质纳米颗粒基因递送系统已多次在临床试验中失败，并且难以在靶组织中实现高效、局部的转染。多数被内吞的纳米颗粒会在核酸释放前被降解，而无法在体内追踪颗粒分布，使得成功递送难以验证。另一种选择是纳米气泡（NBs）：它们是脂质包壳、气核的临床前超声造影剂和刺激响应型药物递送载体。在不同声压下，NBs 会膨胀、收缩和破裂，以可由外部控制的、位点特异性的方式释放载荷，同时散射独特回波以实现同步超声可视化。本文介绍了一种阳离子纳米气泡（CNB）配方，其 ζ 电位为 +42.3 mV、直径为 265 nm、浓度为 2.43×10 11 NBs/mL。CNBs 产生稳定的超声对比度，通过静电作用将质粒 DNA 负载于表面，并在体外 15 分钟内进入超过 99% 的人前列腺癌细胞。CNBs 在细胞内仍保持明亮的回声性，并诱导依赖声波照射的绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）表达。在体内，静脉给药后 CNBs 可在小鼠肝脏中产生持续 50 分钟的对比度。对肝脏施加治疗性超声会导致超声对比度急剧下降，从而可视化靶器官内局部空化，并使抗 GFP 平均荧光强度相对于未转染对照增加 2.5 倍。重要的是，未进行超声刺激时未观察到 GFP 表达，这支持一种选择性、位点特异性基因递送机制。本研究提出了一种高度稳定的 CNB，能够高效负载 DNA 并实现依赖超声的基因表达。这些结果为未来开发 CNB 平台、推进图像引导的超声触发基因治疗奠定了基础。

items.abstract_or_text: > One could even define intelligence as the efficiency with which one converts experience into competence; by this definition they lag very far behind us Yes, one could define intelligence in this way, and one would be right. By this metric current AI is approximately 6 OOMs less intelligent than humans. Your ancestors' evolutionary history did not prepare you for Python programming, yet you can learn to competently program in Python in a few hundreds of hours. An LRM needs the training data equivalent of ~1B hours (on top of all of its non-programming related training data). Another dimension where which current AI is far below human level is test-time compute efficiency and energy efficiency. A human can solve an ARC-AGI-3 game by burning an amount of energy that would cost under 0.1 at retail electricity prices. Astra costs about 300-400 per game. That's a 3-4 OOM gap.
items.summary_zh: François Chollet 提出，应以“将经验转化为能力的效率”界定智能；据此，他认为当前 AI 在样本、测试时计算和能耗效率上仍远低于人类。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该帖将智能讨论转向数据与能耗效率，能推动对能力指标的专业讨论；其中数量级比较是作者的估算与定义选择，不应视为通行基准结论。
items.abstract_zh: “人们甚至可以把智能定义为将经验转化为能力的效率；按这一定义，它们远远落后于我们。”是的，人们可以这样定义智能，而且这是对的。按这个指标，当前 AI 大约比人类低 6 个数量级。你的祖先的演化历史并没有让你为 Python 编程做好准备，但你可以在几百小时内学会熟练地用 Python 编程。一个 LRM 需要相当于约 10 亿小时的训练数据（还不包括与编程无关的所有训练数据）。当前 AI 远低于人类的另一维度是测试时计算效率和能效。一个人解决一局 ARC-AGI-3 所消耗的能量，按零售电价计算成本低于 0.1。Astra 每局成本约 300—400。这相差 3—4 个数量级。

items.abstract_or_text: Great paper from Amazon. In discusses when not to trust LLM judges for agent evaluation. (bookmark it) A common way to compare task agents is to have an LLM user simulator talk to each one and an LLM judge score the transcript. This paper from Amazon shows that gate fails in two specific ways. 1. Satisfaction does not track success. 57.5% of conversations the raters marked satisfied had failed the customer's task. 2. Close calls go wrong. The ranking holds across agents of very different ability, but among near-equal agents the gate picks the lower-reward one on 31% of pairs, compared with under 1% for pairs far apart. The study covers 25 agents from six providers on tau2-bench and SimulatorArena. Judges also favored agents from their own model family. The fix is cheap. A judge-free completion bit catches truncation regressions, and the judge is trusted only after calibration against a verifiable reward.
items.summary_zh: DAIR.AI 转述一项 Amazon 研究：在 25 个、来自六家提供商的智能体上，LLM 裁判的满意度判断与任务成功可能脱钩，且能力接近的智能体比较更易误判。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 这是对智能体评测实践的具体警示；帖文给出了数据与校准建议，但属于对论文的二手转述，具体结论仍应以原论文核验为准。
items.abstract_zh: 一篇来自 Amazon 的很棒论文。它讨论了在智能体评估中何时不应信任 LLM 裁判。（值得收藏）比较任务型智能体的常见做法是，让 LLM 用户模拟器同每个智能体对话，再由 LLM 裁判为对话记录评分。这篇 Amazon 论文显示，这道关卡会以两种特定方式失效。1. 满意度并不追踪成功。标注者判为满意的对话中，有 57.5% 未完成客户任务。2. 结果接近时会判断失误。这一排序在能力差异很大的智能体之间仍然成立，但在能力接近的智能体中，该关卡在 31% 的配对中选中了奖励更低者；相较之下，能力差距大的配对中该比例低于 1%。研究覆盖了来自六家提供商的 25 个智能体，基准为 tau2-bench 和 SimulatorArena。裁判还偏向其自身模型家族的智能体。修复成本很低：一个不依赖裁判的完成标记可以捕捉截断回归，并且只有在针对可验证奖励完成校准后才应信任裁判。

items.title: Heterogeneous graph neural networks with biological prior knowledge for interpretable drug repurposing in triple-negative breast cancer
items.abstract_or_text: Drug repurposing offers a cost-effective path to new therapies for triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), a subtype with limited targeted treatment options. We present PRECISION, a framework integrating transcription factor (TF) regulatory networks, protein-protein interactions, and drug-target edges into a heterogeneous graph neural network (GNN) to identify TFs mediating drug sensitivity and prioritize repurposing candidates. The knowledge graph has 23,498 nodes and approximately 830,000 edges from CollecTRI, OmniPath and the PRISM screen. In a fair cell-line hold-out evaluation, the GNN matches ML baselines in global prediction (Pearson r = 0.76). Per-drug mechanistic attributions via Integrated Gradients on the trained GNN, replicated across three independent training seeds and robust to baseline choice (Spearman's rho = 0.94 between the mean and the random Gaussian baselines), highlight stress-response (CREB3L1), epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT; KLF8, ZEB1), stromal/TNBC-specific (AEBP1, MZF1), and epithelial (SPDEF) regulators as stable mediators of drug response. Multi-cohort validation in SCAN-B (n = 7,397), METABRIC (n = 1,979), and TCGA-BRCA (n = 1,072) shows that predicted drug sensitivity is associated with overall survival in 623 drugs in SCAN-B and 74 in METABRIC (FDR < 0.05). Fisher's meta-analysis identifies 551 drugs at FDR < 0.05, validated by positive controls paclitaxel (p_adj = 8.6x10-3), docetaxel (3.1x10-2), epirubicin (3.2x10-6), and talazoparib (1.4x10-4). Paired Wilcoxon tests in 39 AURORA-US patients with matched primary and metastatic samples confirm that 4 of the 10 IG-identified TFs (CREB3L1, KLF8, AEBP1, SPDEF) are significantly altered during metastatic progression after Bonferroni correction. An explicit rule applied to the PAM50-adjusted Cox multivariate results (penalizer = 0.1) selects seven candidates (osimertinib, saracatinib, erlotinib, brigatinib, pelitinib, entinostat, trametinib), revealing pharmacological convergence on the EGFR signaling axis.
items.summary_zh: PRECISION 将转录因子调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合为异质 GNN，用于三阴性乳腺癌药物再定位；作者以细胞系留出、多队列生存关联及 39 例配对样本评估，提出 7 个候选药物并指向 EGFR 信号轴。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究同时提供预测、机制归因及跨队列关联验证，是可解释药物再定位的较完整计算框架。结果主要基于细胞系与观察性患者数据，药物敏感性关联和候选优先级不能直接等同于临床疗效。
items.abstract_zh: 药物再定位为三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）提供了一条经济有效的新疗法路径；该亚型的靶向治疗选择有限。我们提出 PRECISION，这是一个将转录因子（TF）调控网络、蛋白—蛋白相互作用和药物—靶点边整合到异质图神经网络（GNN）中的框架，用以识别介导药物敏感性的 TF 并优先排序再定位候选药物。该知识图谱包含 23,498 个节点和约 830,000 条边，数据来自 CollecTRI、OmniPath 和 PRISM 筛选。在公平的细胞系留出评估中，GNN 在全局预测上与 ML 基线方法相当（Pearson r = 0.76）。在已训练 GNN 上通过 Integrated Gradients 得到的逐药物机制归因，在三个独立训练随机种子中得到复现，并且对基线选择具有稳健性（均值基线与随机高斯基线之间的 Spearman's rho = 0.94）；这些归因凸显了作为稳定药物反应介导因子的应激反应（CREB3L1）、上皮—间质转化（EMT；KLF8、ZEB1）、基质/TNBC 特异性（AEBP1、MZF1）和上皮性（SPDEF）调控因子。在 SCAN-B（n = 7,397）、METABRIC（n = 1,979）和 TCGA-BRCA（n = 1,072）中的多队列验证表明，预测药物敏感性与 SCAN-B 中 623 种药物和 METABRIC 中 74 种药物的总生存相关（FDR < 0.05）。Fisher 元分析识别出 551 种 FDR < 0.05 的药物，并由阳性对照 paclitaxel（p_adj = 8.6x10-3）、docetaxel（3.1x10-2）、epirubicin（3.2x10-6）和 talazoparib（1.4x10-4）验证。在 39 名具有配对原发和转移样本的 AURORA-US 患者中，配对 Wilcoxon 检验确认，经 Bonferroni 校正后，10 个由 IG 识别的 TF 中有 4 个（CREB3L1、KLF8、AEBP1、SPDEF）在转移进展期间显著改变。对 PAM50 校正的 Cox 多变量结果（penalizer = 0.1）应用显式规则，筛选出 7 个候选药物（osimertinib、saracatinib、erlotinib、brigatinib、pelitinib、entinostat、trametinib），揭示其药理学上汇聚于 EGFR 信号轴。

items.title: TransBind2: Improving Transcription Factor-DNA Binding Prediction with Multimodal Data and Bidirectional Cross Attention
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate genome-wide prediction of transcription factor (TF)-DNA binding remains challenging because many models focus mainly on DNA sequence and overlook chromatin context and TF structure. We previously developed TransBind, a protein-aware model that combines TF and DNA representations through cross-attention. Here, we introduce TransBind2, which improves on TransBind in several ways. It incorporates DNase-seq accessibility and genome mappability tracks as additional input, uses a biomodal protein language model (ProstT5) to capture both TF sequence and structure, and applies bidirectional cross-attention so DNA and protein features can refine each other. We also frame prediction as binary classification of individual triplets, allowing the model to generalize to new TFs and cell types. Across 690 human ChIP-seq experiments covering 161 TFs and 91 cell types, TransBind2 achieves a macro AUROC of 0.9648 and AUPR of 0.4215, outperforming TransBind and other baselines, with a ≥12.67% relative AUPR gain. The model trained on human data also performs well in cross-species zero-shot prediction on mouse data. Saliency analysis shows that it can identify TF-binding peaks with a median error of 12-38 base pairs (bps) despite being trained on window-level labels. Ablation studies further show that TF structure, chromatin accessibility, and bidirectional attention each improve performance. Overall, these results show that combining TF structure with chromatin context leads to more accurate and generalizable TF-DNA binding predictions.
items.summary_zh: TransBind2 以 DNA 序列、DNase-seq 可及性、基因组可比对性和 ProstT5 的 TF 序列—结构表示为输入，在 690 个 ChIP-seq 实验、161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型上报告宏平均 AUROC 0.9648。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 模型将蛋白结构和染色质语境纳入 TF-DNA 结合预测，并提供消融与跨物种零样本评估；其性能结论目前仍来自预印本中的计算基准。
items.abstract_zh: 准确的全基因组转录因子（TF）-DNA 结合预测仍具挑战性，因为许多模型主要关注 DNA 序列，而忽略染色质语境和 TF 结构。我们此前开发了 TransBind，这是一种通过交叉注意力结合 TF 和 DNA 表示的蛋白质感知模型。本文介绍 TransBind2，其在多个方面改进了 TransBind。它将 DNase-seq 可及性和基因组可比对性轨道作为附加输入，使用双模态蛋白质语言模型（ProstT5）同时捕获 TF 序列和结构，并应用双向交叉注意力，使 DNA 和蛋白质特征能够彼此细化。我们还将预测表述为单个三元组的二分类任务，使模型可泛化至新的 TF 和细胞类型。在覆盖 161 个 TF 和 91 种细胞类型的 690 个人人类 ChIP-seq 实验中，TransBind2 达到 0.9648 的宏平均 AUROC 和 0.4215 的 AUPR，优于 TransBind 和其他基线，AUPR 相对提升至少 12.67%。在小鼠数据上，该模型在由人类数据训练后的跨物种零样本预测中也表现良好。显著性分析表明，尽管模型以窗口级标签训练，它仍能以 12-38 个碱基对（bps）的中位误差识别 TF 结合峰。消融研究进一步表明，TF 结构、染色质可及性和双向注意力各自均能提升性能。总体而言，这些结果表明，将 TF 结构与染色质语境结合可带来更准确且更具泛化性的 TF-DNA 结合预测。

items.title: Diagnostic Performance of Agentic AI for Rare Disease Diagnosis: A Systematic Review, Meta-analysis, Workflow Development, and Benchmark-based Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Rare diseases are characterized by diverse disease entities, heterogeneous phenotypes, complex diagnostic processes, and reliance on specialized expertise, resulting in substantial diagnostic delays. Large language models (LLMs) and Agentic artificial intelligence (Agentic AI) have recently been introduced into medical diagnosis. Compared with standalone LLMs, Agentic AI incorporates planning, external knowledge retrieval, iterative reasoning, and feedback mechanisms to improve complex diagnostic tasks. However, the overall diagnostic performance of Agentic AI in rare disease diagnosis and its transferable core workflows remain unclear. Methods A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted using PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, arXiv, and medRxiv/bioRxiv. Studies applying Agentic AI for rare disease diagnosis with extractable Top-1 diagnostic accuracy were included. Recall@1 was synthesized using a random effects single arm meta analysis, with leave-one-out sensitivity analysis. Agent capabilities were standardized using a unified capability taxonomy derived from existing agent frameworks. A lightweight workflow was subsequently constructed based on recurrently reported capabilities and evaluated using 50 randomly selected RareBench cases. The workflow-assisted Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) model was compared with the same model operating in standalone mode using Recall@1, Recall@3, and Recall@5. Results Seven studies contributing 19 effect estimates and 33,738 cases were included. The pooled Recall@1 was 51.2% (95% confidence interval [CI], 45.3% − 57.1%), and substantial heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 98.5%). Leave-one-out analysis demonstrated robustness of the pooled estimate. Capability synthesis identified reasoning and hypothesis refinement and planning and task decomposition as the most consistently reported capabilities (7/7), followed by tool use and external knowledge integration and traceability and explainability (6/7). In RareBench validation, the workflow-assisted model improved Top-1 diagnosis compared with standalone GPT, achieving 11/50 correct diagnoses versus 5/50. Case level comparison showed that the workflow corrected 7 baseline errors, whereas baseline performance was superior in 1 case (exact McNemar test, P = 0.0703). Conclusions Agentic AI has demonstrated a certain level of diagnostic performance in rare disease diagnosis. However, diagnostic performance varies across different agent systems. In this study, we integrated the workflows reported in the included studies. The resulting workflow incorporates structured reasoning, external knowledge retrieval, and evidence tracking. This approach may provide a reproducible method for improving large language model based diagnostic systems. Future studies should develop more comprehensive workflows and conduct larger scale external validation. Ablation studies are also needed to determine the specific contribution of each agentic capability.

items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 罕见病具有疾病实体多样、表型异质、诊断流程复杂并依赖专门知识等特点，导致显著的诊断延迟。大语言模型（LLMs）和 Agentic artificial intelligence（Agentic AI）近期已被引入医学诊断。与独立 LLM 相比，Agentic AI 融入规划、外部知识检索、迭代推理和反馈机制，以改进复杂诊断任务。然而，Agentic AI 在罕见病诊断中的总体诊断性能及其可迁移的核心工作流尚不明确。方法 使用 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science、Cochrane Library、arXiv 和 medRxiv/bioRxiv 开展系统综述和 Meta 分析。纳入应用 Agentic AI 进行罕见病诊断且可提取 Top-1 诊断准确率的研究。采用随机效应单臂 Meta 分析汇总 Recall@1，并进行逐一剔除敏感性分析。使用从现有 Agent 框架导出的统一能力分类法对 Agent 能力进行标准化。随后基于反复报告的能力构建轻量级工作流，并使用随机选取的 50 个 RareBench 病例进行评估。使用 Recall@1、Recall@3 和 Recall@5，将工作流辅助的 Generative Pre-trained Transformer（GPT）模型与以独立模式运行的同一模型进行比较。结果 纳入了 7 项研究，贡献 19 个效应量和 33,738 个病例。合并 Recall@1 为 51.2%（95% 置信区间 [CI]，45.3% − 57.1%），并观察到显著异质性（I 2 = 98.5%）。逐一剔除分析显示合并估计具有稳健性。能力综合显示，推理与假设细化、规划与任务分解是报告最一致的能力（7/7），其次是工具使用与外部知识整合、可追溯性与可解释性（6/7）。在 RareBench 验证中，工作流辅助模型相较独立 GPT 改善了 Top-1 诊断，达到 11/50 个正确诊断，而独立 GPT 为 5/50。病例级比较显示，该工作流纠正了 7 个基线错误，而基线在 1 个病例中表现更好（精确 McNemar 检验，P = 0.0703）。结论 Agentic AI 已在罕见病诊断中显示出一定水平的诊断性能。然而，不同 Agent 系统之间的诊断性能存在差异。本研究整合了纳入研究中报告的工作流。所得工作流纳入结构化推理、外部知识检索和证据追踪。这一方法可能为改进基于大语言模型的诊断系统提供可复现的方法。未来研究应开发更全面的工作流，并开展更大规模的外部验证。还需要消融研究来确定每项 Agent 能力的具体贡献。

items.title: An Interpretable Machine Learning Framework for Predicting In-Hospital Mortality in Patients with Heart Failure and Concurrent Infection: Development Using MIMIC-IV and External Validation in eICU-CRD
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Background Patients with heart failure and concurrent infection are at increased risk of adverse in-hospital outcomes because cardiac dysfunction, systemic inflammation, organ impairment, and acute physiological deterioration may occur simultaneously. This study aimed to develop and externally evaluate machine learning models for predicting in-hospital mortality in this high-risk population and to characterize model predictions using SHAP analysis. Methods Adults with heart failure and concurrent infection were identified from the Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV (MIMIC-IV) database and the eICU Collaborative Research Database (eICU-CRD). A total of 1,415 patients from MIMIC-IV were used for model development and internal evaluation, while 2,826 patients from eICU-CRD were used for external validation. Patients were classified as survivors or non-survivors according to their in-hospital discharge status. Four machine learning models—logistic regression, AdaBoost, XGBoost, and LightGBM—were developed and evaluated. Model performance was assessed using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, accuracy, precision, and F1-score. Performance was further examined in bacterial-infection and non-bacterial-infection subgroups. SHAP analysis was applied to the XGBoost model to characterize the contribution of individual features to model predictions. Results In the MIMIC-IV internal test set, LightGBM achieved the highest observed AUC in the overall cohort and the bacterial-infection subgroup, with AUCs of 0.836 and 0.818, respectively. XGBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the non-bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.846. In the eICU-CRD external validation cohort, AdaBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.746, whereas XGBoost achieved the highest observed AUC in the non-bacterial-infection subgroup, with an AUC of 0.725. Thus, model discrimination varied across databases and infection subgroups, and no single algorithm demonstrated consistently superior performance across all evaluation cohorts. SHAP analysis identified the Glasgow Coma Scale score, white blood cell count, blood urea nitrogen, body weight, and urine output among the influential features contributing to the XGBoost predictions. Conclusions The performance of the evaluated machine learning models varied across databases and infection subgroups. SHAP analysis provided model-level explanations of the XGBoost predictions but should not be interpreted as evidence of causal relationships or independent risk factors. These findings support the potential value of interpretable machine learning as an exploratory framework for risk stratification in patients with heart failure and concurrent infection. Prospective multicentre validation, calibration assessment, and evaluation of clinical utility are required before clinical implementation.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 MIMIC-IV 的 1,415 名心力衰竭合并感染患者建模，并以 eICU-CRD 的 2,826 名患者外部验证；外部队列中最高 AUC 为细菌感染亚组 0.746、非细菌感染亚组 0.725。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究明确呈现了跨数据库和感染亚组的性能下降及不稳定性，并避免把 SHAP 归因解读为风险因素或因果证据；临床实施仍需前瞻性多中心验证、校准和效用评估。
items.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 心力衰竭合并感染的患者因心功能障碍、全身炎症、器官损害和急性生理恶化可能同时发生，住院期间不良结局风险增加。本研究旨在开发并外部评估用于预测这一高风险人群院内死亡的机器学习模型，并使用 SHAP 分析表征模型预测。方法 从 Medical Information Mart for Intensive Care IV（MIMIC-IV）数据库和 eICU Collaborative Research Database（eICU-CRD）中识别心力衰竭合并感染的成年患者。来自 MIMIC-IV 的共 1,415 名患者用于模型开发和内部评估，来自 eICU-CRD 的 2,826 名患者用于外部验证。依据住院出院状态将患者分为存活者或非存活者。开发并评估了四种机器学习模型——逻辑回归、AdaBoost、XGBoost 和 LightGBM。使用受试者工作特征曲线下面积、准确率、精确率和 F1 分数评估模型性能。还在细菌感染和非细菌感染亚组中考察性能。对 XGBoost 模型应用 SHAP 分析，以表征各特征对模型预测的贡献。结果 在 MIMIC-IV 内部测试集中，LightGBM 在总体队列和细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，分别为 0.836 和 0.818。XGBoost 在非细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.846。在 eICU-CRD 外部验证队列中，AdaBoost 在细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.746；而 XGBoost 在非细菌感染亚组中取得最高观察到的 AUC，为 0.725。因此，模型区分度在数据库和感染亚组之间存在差异，没有单一算法在所有评估队列中持续表现更优。SHAP 分析将 Glasgow Coma Scale 评分、白细胞计数、血尿素氮、体重和尿量识别为对 XGBoost 预测有影响的特征。结论 所评估的机器学习模型性能在数据库和感染亚组间存在差异。SHAP 分析为 XGBoost 预测提供了模型层面的解释，但不应被解读为因果关系或独立危险因素的证据。这些发现支持可解释机器学习作为心力衰竭合并感染患者风险分层探索性框架的潜在价值。在临床实施前，需要进行前瞻性多中心验证、校准评估和临床效用评价。

items.title: Single-cell transcriptomic and epigenomic analysis reveals X-linked sex differences in aging mouse hypothalamus
items.abstract_or_text: Sex differences contribute to brain aging, neurodegenerative diseases, and more broadly in determining rates of aging across species. The hypothalamus plays a central role in physiological homeostasis and healthy aging, yet how its cellular and molecular landscape diverges between males and females over the lifespan remains poorly understood. Here, we present a single-nucleus multi-omics analysis of the hypothalamus in young, middle aged, and aged male and female mice. We identified major hypothalamic cell types and characterized their sex- and age-dependent transcriptional and chromatin accessibility profiles. Notably, female-specific changes on the X chromosome (chrX) emerged as a prominent feature of aging, including changes to the X inactivation center and an overall increase in chrX gene expression and accessibility in immune cells and neurons. Pseudotime analysis of immune cells revealed an aging trajectory with sex-specific multi-omic programs, featuring increased inflammation in females compared to males. Delving deeper into the epigenetic signatures associated with these sex differences, we found that H3K27me3 - the repressive histone mark enriched on the inactive X in females - increased in abundance and underwent substantial genome-wide redistribution with age in both sexes, particularly on the inactive chrX in females. Collectively, these findings highlight distinct cell-type-specific aging trajectories in the male and female hypothalamus, identify female aging signatures associated with X-linked epigenetic regulatory programs, and provide a comprehensive resource for understanding the molecular basis of sex differences in brain aging.
items.summary_zh: 研究对青年、中年和老年雌雄小鼠下丘脑进行单核多组学分析，发现随年龄出现的雌性 chrX 特异性表达和开放性改变，以及具有性别差异的免疫细胞衰老轨迹。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究把转录组、染色质可及性和 H3K27me3 的年龄相关重分布连到细胞类型分辨率的性别差异，为脑衰老机制研究提供资源；结果来自小鼠，不能直接外推至人类疾病。
items.abstract_zh: 性别差异会影响脑衰老、神经退行性疾病，并更广泛地决定跨物种的衰老速率。下丘脑在生理稳态和健康衰老中发挥核心作用，但在整个生命周期中，其细胞和分子图谱如何在雄性和雌性之间分化仍知之甚少。本文对青年、中年和老年雄性及雌性小鼠的下丘脑进行了单核多组学分析。我们鉴定出主要下丘脑细胞类型，并表征了其依赖性别和年龄的转录及染色质可及性图谱。值得注意的是，X 染色体（chrX）上的雌性特异性变化成为衰老的突出特征，包括 X 失活中心的变化，以及免疫细胞和神经元中 chrX 基因表达和可及性的总体升高。免疫细胞的拟时序分析揭示了一条具有性别特异性多组学程序的衰老轨迹，其中雌性的炎症增加程度高于雄性。进一步深入分析与这些性别差异相关的表观遗传特征后，我们发现 H3K27me3——在雌性失活 X 染色体上富集的抑制性组蛋白标记——在两种性别中均随年龄增加丰度，并发生显著的全基因组重分布，尤其是在雌性的失活 chrX 上。总体而言，这些发现突出了雄性和雌性下丘脑中不同的细胞类型特异性衰老轨迹，鉴定出与 X 连锁表观遗传调控程序相关的雌性衰老特征，并为理解脑衰老中性别差异的分子基础提供了综合资源。

items.title: The protein and lipid compositions of brain apolipoprotein E particles are cell type-specific
items.abstract_or_text: Genetic variation in APOE, which encodes a lipid transporter apolipoprotein E (apoE), is the strongest risk factor for late-onset Alzheimer's disease (AD). Although central nervous system (CNS) apoE is produced by various cell types, including astrocytes, microglia, and pericytes, it is unclear whether apoE lipoproteins are a homogeneous population or if their molecular composition varies depending on their cellular origin. Emerging evidence suggests that CNS apoE lipoproteins contribute to AD-related processes, including amyloid deposition, neuroinflammation, synaptic maintenance, and blood-brain barrier function in a cell type-specific manner. We hypothesized that the compositions of CNS apoE lipoproteins depend on their cellular origin and investigated the lipid and protein profiles of apoE particles secreted by induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived brain cells and derived from human cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) using liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Our results demonstrate that astrocytes, pericytes, and microglia secrete apoE lipoproteins with distinct, cell type-specific lipid and protein profiles. Astrocyte-secreted particles were enriched in sphingomyelins and proteins linked to lipid metabolism, whereas pericyte-secreted particles contained ether-linked phospholipids and proteins associated with antioxidant activity. The lipidation of microglial apoE was markedly lower, but these particles had higher levels of transferrin, apoC-II, and cathepsin D. Notably, one-third of identified features were cell type-specific, highlighting the substantial molecular specialization across cell types. Most lipids and proteins identified in cell-secreted apoE were also detected in CSF-derived particles. Our findings advance the understanding of apoE biology by shifting the focus from apoE as a single, homogeneous entity to a diverse population of complex particles, the composition of which might be linked to functions in health and neurodegenerative diseases.
items.summary_zh: 研究以 iPSC 来源星形胶质细胞、周细胞和小胶质细胞及人脑脊液样本为材料，利用 LC-MS/MS 显示 apoE 颗粒的脂质和蛋白组成具有明显细胞类型特异性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该结果细化了 APOE/apoE 作为阿尔茨海默病风险相关分子的细胞来源异质性；它描述的是分子组成和潜在功能联系，尚未证明这些颗粒差异导致疾病过程。
items.abstract_zh: 编码脂质转运蛋白载脂蛋白 E（apoE）的 APOE 遗传变异，是晚发性阿尔茨海默病（AD）最强的风险因素。尽管中枢神经系统（CNS）中的 apoE 由包括星形胶质细胞、小胶质细胞和周细胞在内的多种细胞类型产生，但尚不清楚 apoE 脂蛋白是否为同质群体，或其分子组成是否随细胞来源而变化。新近证据提示，CNS apoE 脂蛋白以细胞类型特异性的方式参与 AD 相关过程，包括淀粉样蛋白沉积、神经炎症、突触维持和血脑屏障功能。我们假设 CNS apoE 脂蛋白的组成取决于其细胞来源，并利用液相色谱—质谱（LC-MS/MS）研究了由诱导多能干细胞（iPSC）来源脑细胞分泌的 apoE 颗粒以及从人脑脊液（CSF）中获得的 apoE 颗粒的脂质和蛋白图谱。结果表明，星形胶质细胞、周细胞和小胶质细胞分泌的 apoE 脂蛋白具有不同的、细胞类型特异性的脂质和蛋白图谱。星形胶质细胞分泌的颗粒富含鞘磷脂和与脂质代谢相关的蛋白；周细胞分泌的颗粒含有醚键磷脂和与抗氧化活性相关的蛋白。小胶质细胞 apoE 的脂化程度显著较低，但这些颗粒具有更高水平的转铁蛋白、apoC-II 和组织蛋白酶 D。值得注意的是，三分之一已鉴定特征具有细胞类型特异性，突出了跨细胞类型的显著分子特化。细胞分泌 apoE 中鉴定出的绝大多数脂质和蛋白也在 CSF 来源颗粒中检出。我们的发现通过将关注点从 apoE 作为单一同质实体转向一类多样化的复杂颗粒，推进了对 apoE 生物学的理解；这些颗粒的组成可能与健康和神经退行性疾病中的功能有关。

items.title: HARIBOSS++: An Integrated Platform for RNA-Targeted Drug Design
items.abstract_or_text: Targeting RNA with small molecules is increasingly viewed as a pivotal strategy for future therapeutics. A major limitation in studying RNA-small molecule (RNA-SM) interactions is the lack of available experimental structures. HARIBOSS established a milestone as a curated database of RNA-SM complexes derived from the Protein Data Bank. Building on its community engagement, we present HARIBOSS++, an updated and next-generation platform designed to facilitate the study of future RNA-targeted drugs. Major updates include an extension of the pocketome to encompass binding sites where small molecules interact not only with RNA but also with other biomolecules, enhanced analysis of RNA molecules by family, detailed 3D structural characterization, improved analysis of ligands chemical space, addition of experimental binding affinity as well as molecular dynamics data, when available. HARIBOSS++ opens new avenues for biologists, bioinformaticians, and machine learning researchers to investigate RNA-SM interactions on a new scale. HARIBOSS++ can be explored using a web interface freely available at https://hariboss.pasteur.cloud.
items.summary_zh: HARIBOSS++ 扩展了源自 Protein Data Bank 的 RNA—小分子复合物资源，将 RNA 及其与其他生物分子共同形成的结合位点、RNA 家族和三维特征、配体化学空间，以及可获得的实验亲和力和分子动力学数据纳入统一平台。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RNA 靶向小分子缺乏实验结构是设计和机器学习的核心瓶颈，该平台可为结构分析与数据驱动建模提供更系统的入口。资源的覆盖度和不同数据类型的可用性仍受既有实验结构及沉积数据限制。
items.abstract_zh: 用小分子靶向 RNA 日益被视为未来治疗学的关键策略。研究 RNA—小分子（RNA-SM）相互作用的一个主要限制是缺乏可用的实验结构。HARIBOSS 作为源自 Protein Data Bank 的 RNA-SM 复合物精选数据库，树立了一个里程碑。在其社区参与的基础上，我们提出 HARIBOSS++，这是一个更新的下一代平台，旨在促进未来 RNA 靶向药物的研究。主要更新包括：将口袋组扩展至小分子不仅与 RNA、也与其他生物分子相互作用的结合位点；按家族增强对 RNA 分子的分析；详细的三维结构表征；改进的配体化学空间分析；以及在可获得时加入实验结合亲和力和分子动力学数据。HARIBOSS++ 为生物学家、生物信息学家和机器学习研究者以新的规模研究 RNA-SM 相互作用开辟了新途径。HARIBOSS++ 可通过免费提供的网页界面 https://hariboss.pasteur.cloud 访问。

items.title: Mechanistic Interpretability of Protein Language Models Reveals Encoded Structural and Functional Properties of Intrinsically Disordered Proteins
items.abstract_or_text: Protein language models (PLMs) such as ESM-2 encode protein sequences as embeddings for downstream tasks. PLMs are trained on a masked learning objective that leverages evolutionary constraints. While interpretability studies of ESM-2 have focused on folded proteins, their behavior on intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs), which constitute a substantial fraction of the human proteome and are implicated in numerous diseases, remains understudied. Because IDPs experience different types of evolutionary constraints on their amino acid sequences, we hypothesized that PLMs would behave differently on disordered versus folded regions. Here we show that ESM-2 exhibits reduced attention on disordered regions, yet still encodes meaningful biological signals. The model assigns heightened attention to disease-relevant residues even at high levels of disorder. Moreover, we show that both the radius of gyration and individual dynamic contact maps, key characteristics of IDPs, can be obtained from the model logits and embeddings. These findings suggest PLMs capture valuable information relevant to IDP biology despite their bias toward structured residues.
items.summary_zh: 研究指出 ESM-2 虽对无序区的注意力较低，仍可编码与疾病相关残基、回转半径和动态接触图有关的信息，从而扩展了蛋白质语言模型的可解释性范围。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 内在无序蛋白在人体蛋白质组和疾病中广泛存在；该工作为从 PLM 表示中读取其结构—功能信号提供了可检验假设，但未取代实验结构或动力学测量。
items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）如 ESM-2 将蛋白质序列编码为可用于下游任务的嵌入。PLMs 以利用进化约束的掩码学习目标进行训练。尽管针对 ESM-2 的可解释性研究聚焦于折叠蛋白，但对于构成人类蛋白质组相当大比例、并与多种疾病相关的内在无序蛋白（IDPs），其行为仍研究不足。由于 IDPs 的氨基酸序列经历不同类型的进化约束，我们假设 PLMs 在无序区域与折叠区域上的行为不同。本文显示，ESM-2 对无序区域的注意力降低，但仍编码了有意义的生物学信号。即使在高度无序条件下，该模型也会对疾病相关残基赋予更高注意力。此外，我们显示，IDPs 的关键特征——回转半径和单个动态接触图——均可从模型 logits 和嵌入中获得。这些发现表明，尽管 PLMs 偏向结构化残基，它们仍捕获了与 IDP 生物学相关的有价值信息。

items.title: Interaction Profiles as a Universal Language for Generative Molecular Design with ShEPhERD-2
items.abstract_or_text: Three-dimensional intermolecular interactions govern molecular recognition and are fundamental to the pharmacological activity of small-molecule drugs. We propose that an interaction profile, comprising shape, electrostatics, and directional pharmacophores, is a sufficient and transferable design specification for molecular design. We introduce ShEPhERD-2, a 3D generative model that generates molecular structures conditioned on explicit interaction profiles. ShEPhERD–2 generates low-strain, drug-like molecules more efficiently and with greater fidelity to target interaction profiles than its predecessor while enabling precise control over molecular design through pharmacophore prioritization, substructure constraints, and composition of multiple interaction profiles. We demonstrate the application of a single model to bioisosteric fragment merging, dual-target design, selectivity engineering, and modality hopping without task-specific retraining. These results establish interaction profiles as a chemotype-agnostic interface between structure hypotheses and molecular design.

But the formulas they developed weren’t guaranteed to describe all possible conditions. Mathematicians have spent decades trying to either prove that the equations can do that or, alternatively, that there are situations in which the equations break down and give a nonsensical result. Now, OpenAI claims it has solved the Navier-Stokes problem. Thanks to an 88-hour assault by some 10,000 artificial intelligence agents—AI systems that can act autonomously—the company found a case where the equations falter.
